anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential over-utilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any learning cycles, confidence, opportunities, or adjustments, suggesting it may not be functioning as intended.
Trading system shows no active trades and zero total profit/loss, which is unusual for a trading platform.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system performance.
Review and potentially restart or debug the AI system to ensure it is actively learning and generating trading opportunities.
Evaluate trading strategies and market conditions to ensure they are aligned with current market trends and platform goals.

recommendations.action: Conduct an immediate investigation into the high CPU load and identify processes that are causing the bottleneck.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, affecting trading operations and user experience.

recommendations.action: Perform a diagnostic check on the AI system to determine why it is not generating learning cycles or opportunities.
